boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Haverford College
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food and essentials stops with directly documented evening hours on campus and along the nearby Main Line.

cards.title: Late Night Fare at the DC
cards.subtitle: The on-campus option for a meal before 10 p.m.
cards.notes: Go Monday through Thursday between 8 and 10 p.m. for the Dining Center’s explicitly scheduled Late Night Fare service.
cards.short_summary: Haverford’s own dining hall provides the board’s closest documented late-evening meal period.
cards.evidence_claim: Haverford College lists Late Night Fare at the Dining Center from 8:00–10:00 p.m. Monday through Thursday.
cards.source_title: Dining Center | Dining Services | Haverford College
cards.access_notes: Late Night Fare is currently listed Monday–Thursday, 8:00–10:00 p.m.; academic breaks and special schedules may differ.

cards.title: Pizza Until 2 in Ardmore
cards.subtitle: A weekend carryout or delivery run on Greenfield Avenue
cards.notes: Use the Ardmore location for a Friday or Saturday pizza order; its official page lists both carryout and delivery until 2 a.m.
cards.short_summary: This Ardmore storefront extends a conventional pizza run well past midnight on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Papa Johns lists delivery and carryout at 24 Greenfield Avenue until 2:00 a.m. Friday and Saturday and midnight Sunday through Thursday.
cards.source_title: Papa Johns Greenfield Ave | Papa Johns Ardmore, PA
cards.access_notes: Carryout and delivery run until 2:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday and 12:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday, according to the location page.

cards.title: The Rittenhouse Place Pizza Run
cards.subtitle: A midnight-or-later option in downtown Ardmore
cards.notes: Head to Rittenhouse Place when the timing calls for pizza late; the restaurant’s hosted menu documents service past midnight on weekends.
cards.short_summary: A downtown Ardmore pizzeria supplies a straightforward late pickup or delivery destination.
cards.evidence_claim: Ardmore Pizza’s directly hosted menu lists hours until midnight Sunday through Thursday and 1:00 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: The hosted menu lists 11:00 a.m.–midnight Sunday–Thursday and 11:00 a.m.–1:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: A Villanova-Side Pizza Run
cards.subtitle: Pizza, sandwiches, snacks, and shakes on Lancaster Avenue
cards.notes: Check the posted schedule before traveling to Villanova; the restaurant documents service through 11 p.m. or midnight on listed nights.
cards.short_summary: This student-oriented counter broadens a late run beyond pizza with sandwiches, snacks, breakfast food, and ice cream.
cards.evidence_claim: Campus Corner Pizza’s official site lists 11:00 p.m. closing Monday and Thursday and midnight closing Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours are Monday and Thursday until 11:00 p.m. and Friday–Saturday until midnight; the site warns summer hours vary.

cards.title: An Ardmore Slice Before 11
cards.subtitle: A Lancaster Avenue pizza counter for Friday or Saturday
cards.notes: Plan this run for Friday or Saturday, when Bella Italia’s own site gives you an extra hour beyond its 10 p.m. weekday closing.
cards.short_summary: A long-running Ardmore pizza shop offers a clearly documented 11 p.m. weekend endpoint.
cards.evidence_claim: Bella Italia Pizza lists Friday and Saturday hours from 10:00 a.m. to 11:00 p.m. at 12 East Lancaster Avenue.
cards.source_title: Home | Bella Italia Pizza Ardmore, PA
cards.access_notes: Open until 11:00 p.m. Friday–Saturday; the official site lists 10:00 p.m. closing Monday–Thursday and Sunday.

cards.title: A Late Seated Dinner in Bryn Mawr
cards.subtitle: A BYOB Italian dining room with an 11 p.m. weekend kitchen
cards.notes: Reserve or arrive before the 10:30 p.m. last seating on Friday or Saturday; the kitchen’s published closing time is 11 p.m.
cards.short_summary: This Bryn Mawr restaurant fits a planned late dinner rather than a quick counter-service run.
cards.evidence_claim: Otto by Polpo lists a 10:30 p.m. last seating and 11:00 p.m. kitchen closing on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Friday–Saturday last seating is 10:30 p.m., with the kitchen closing at 11:00 p.m.; Sunday–Thursday kitchen closes at 10:00 p.m.

cards.title: Bryn Mawr Dinner Through 10
cards.subtitle: A Friday or Saturday Italian dinner on Lancaster Avenue
cards.notes: Use this as a sit-down weekend run and place any takeout order early enough for the official 10 p.m. Friday–Saturday cutoff.
cards.short_summary: The restaurant’s direct ordering page documents a later weekend dinner window and a full savory menu.
cards.evidence_claim: Carina Sorella’s direct Toast ordering page lists Friday and Saturday ordering hours through 10:00 p.m.
cards.access_notes: The direct ordering page lists Friday–Saturday service from 4:00–10:00 p.m.; other evenings end between 9:15 and 9:30 p.m.

cards.title: A Saturday Carryout in Bryn Mawr
cards.subtitle: Pizza and hot-food pickup near Bryn Mawr Hospital
cards.notes: Choose Saturday carryout for the latest window; Lovecchio’s lists pickup until 9:45 p.m., later than its dining and delivery schedule.
cards.short_summary: This Bryn Mawr pizzeria provides a documented late pickup window for pizza, wings, fries, and sandwiches.
cards.evidence_claim: Lovecchio’s official website lists Saturday carryout from 10:00 a.m. until 9:45 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Saturday carryout is listed until 9:45 p.m.; most dining and delivery periods end at 8:45 p.m. or earlier.

cards.title: The 10 p.m. Essentials Run
cards.subtitle: Snacks and everyday supplies in Ardmore
cards.notes: Use the retail store for packaged snacks or forgotten essentials before 10 p.m.; pharmacy service ends earlier and should be checked separately.
cards.short_summary: This Ardmore CVS covers the practical version of a late run when the need is supplies rather than a prepared meal.
cards.evidence_claim: CVS lists its 317 West Lancaster Avenue store and photo department as open until 10:00 p.m.
cards.source_title: CVS Near Me | Ardmore, PA | CVS Pharmacy Locations
cards.access_notes: The retail store and photo counter are listed until 10:00 p.m.; the pharmacy closes earlier, currently at 8:00 p.m.

cards.title: A Havertown Supply Stop Before 10
cards.subtitle: Another late retail option for snacks and essentials
cards.notes: Go for retail items before the 10 p.m. store closing, but do not rely on that time for prescriptions because the pharmacy closes earlier.
cards.short_summary: The West Chester Pike store adds a distinct late-evening essentials option southwest of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: CVS lists the store and photo department at 1109 West Chester Pike in Havertown as open until 10:00 p.m.
cards.source_title: CVS Near Me | Havertown, PA | CVS Pharmacy Locations
cards.access_notes: The retail store and photo counter are listed until 10:00 p.m.; pharmacy service currently ends at 8:00 p.m.
